title: React v2 Mission Control Type Safety and Component Decomposition
goal: Remove the Mission Control TypeScript escape hatch and split the oversized screen into typed, testable components without changing operator behavior.
scope: React v2 Mission Control component structure, local helper extraction, typed UI models, and focused Playwright/TypeScript validation.
generation_reason: Code review found ui-v2/src/components/screens/MissionControl.tsx starts with @ts-nocheck and is about 3000 lines, making active Mission Control work easy to break without TypeScript protection.

review_findings: Mission Control is the active high-change UI surface
npm run build cannot protect this screen while ts-nocheck remains

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: REQUIRES: complete current Mission Control feature slices before broad refactor

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Preserve existing Mission Control behavior and visuals. Refactor for type safety and maintainability, not a redesign.
constraints.no_backend_api_change: Do not add or change backend endpoints for this refactor.

success_criteria: MissionControl.tsx no longer uses @ts-nocheck or blanket unused-vars disabling.
The screen is decomposed into typed child components or hooks for at least run status, task console, AI signal, phase/loop panel, and action controls.
Existing standard run, chain run, queued run, and ai_loop run views remain behaviorally unchanged.
TypeScript build catches Mission Control types normally.
Focused React v2 Playwright coverage still passes for Mission Control critical paths.

required_checks: cd ui-v2 && npm run test:e2e -- --grep "Mission Control"
acceptance_criteria: No @ts-nocheck remains in MissionControl.tsx or extracted Mission Control files.
Mission Control still renders standard, chain, queued, and ai_loop fixtures.
No backend routes, runner behavior, approvals, scope/ROE, credentials, or runtime gates are changed.

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.
after_completion: Promote the next true open task into NEXT_TASK.md, or record that no active backlog task remains in NEXT_TASK.md.

out_of_scope: Adding new backend AI insight endpoints.
Changing approval, dispatch, scope, credential, or kill-switch behavior.
